correctness.rationale: A finite-dimensional semigroup argument gives absorption as the trap cyclic projection; the exact 2-by-2 Gram determinant (m-1)(n-1)(w-1)^2 gives two distinct positive singular values off w=1, each observed by the sink, plus the observed zero mode. Direct calculation yields the full 5D projector, all cases m,n>=3, all w,J,kappa>0. A separate rational Krylov checker matches 64 parameter instances, supplementary only.
